semanticAudit.basis: official-south-sea.svg contains path-converted artwork without an authoritative legend or source note

backdropRect.evidence: One rect element is observable; its semantic role is not certified

outerFrame.evidence: Closed rectangular path geometry is observable; outer-frame meaning is not certified

innerFrame.evidence: Long open/closed frame-like path geometry is observable; inner-frame meaning is not certified

scaleBar.evidence: Short rectangular/segment paths are observable; scale-bar meaning is not certified

convertedText.evidence: No text elements; any converted glyphs cannot be separated reliably

islandGroupSymbols.evidence: Path artwork may include symbols, but no legend supports semantic labeling

shortLineObjects.evidence: Candidates selected only by short path data length; semantic identity is not inferred
shortLineObjects.candidateSelection: path d attribute length <= 140 characters (observable heuristic only)
shortLineObjects.candidateIdsScope: IDs listed are only the hidden 49-object overlap; full official candidate IDs are intentionally not semantically labeled

renderAudit.canvasComparison: 49/49 rendered in browser at 256x181; alpha and RGBA differences recorded per object
renderAudit.pixelComparisonMethod: Browser Image + Canvas rasterization of corresponding path with source style
renderAudit.pixelDifferenceInterpretation: Non-zero RGBA differences are expected when presentation and official styles differ; geometry equality is established separately
